definitions.explanation: The hospital department or medical specialty dealing with disorders of the nervous system. The suffix 〜{科|か} designates a medical specialty.

examples.japanese: {神経科|しんけいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神経科|しんけいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was referred to the hospital's neurology department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{神経科|しんけいか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Since the headaches continued, I had a detailed examination at the neurology department.

notes:
Names a hospital department. The suffix 〜{科|か} forms the names of medical specialties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神経科|しんけいか}{医|い}: neurologist
- {神経科|しんけいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to consult the neurology department

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精神科|せいしんか}→精神科：21587_seishinka⟧: psychiatry — treats mental and emotional disorders
- {神経内科|しんけいないか}: neurology (internal medicine) — the more precise modern department name for nerve and brain disorders
